content: Xzar, x idurar ttazzřen iḍaren n wenni dd-yiwyen řexbar aṣebḥan, wenni ixebbaren s řehna. Ɛeyyed řeɛyudat nnec, a Yahuda, seqfeř lwuɛud nnec, maɣar wenni yareddǧen war ittɣimi iẓekkwi xak ɛad, netta inneqḍeɛ marra.
Ijjen wenni yuẓẓřen x iwdan s lɛunf i dd-igeɛɛed xak! Ɛess x lburj, ḥḍa abrid, semḥeḍ tijɛinna nnec, arni di jjhed nnec!
S minzi SIDI ad dd-yarr řɛezz n Yaɛqub, aqa-t d řɛezz n Israil. Maɣar ikeccaḍen keccḍen ten, u nitni ɣeḍřen tizermin nsen.

Tcappat n useřqi n ayt n bu-teɣruḍt zewɣent, iryazen imeḥḍen bedden sswejden i umenɣi s warruḍ azeggʷaɣ iḥedqen, ɣar tessiqt n tmessi n wuzzař n ikarruten n umenɣi, deg wass i di i ɣa issewjed ixef nnes u ticejjura n umerzi ad nnhezzen.
Ikarruten n umenɣi hajen deg ibriden, aqa ẓẓeɛwaḍen zi ssa ɣar da deg wazzayen, ttwaḍharen am yiṣefḍawen, nitni gemmaren da d diha am wassamen.
Netta ittxarreṣ deg ayt n jjehd, nitni maca ttneqraḍen am gguren nitni ttazzřen ɣar řḥiḍ nsen, mani ibedd ssqef n uhjam iwjed.
Tiwwura n iɣezran nnurezment, u řeqṣar ad ifsi.
Aqa tamesřact tbedd nican! Nettat ad tᵉttwaɛarra, ad tᵉttwassgeɛɛed, u tiyya nnes sɣuyyunt amecnaw abarri n tedbirin, am ccatent deg idmaren nsent.
Ninwa am yijj n uyeřmam n waman zeg wass i di iǧa. Řexxu maca arekkweřen nitni. Beddem! Beddem!, ttřaɣan nitni, maca uřa d ijj war dd-ittneqřib.
Keccḍem nnuqart, keccḍem ureɣ! War din qeṭṭu i řeknuz, ɣar ucewwar n ɛřam kuř řeqcuɛ.
Texwa, tᵉttwakecceḍ u tᵉttwareddeǧ nettat, uř ifsi uca ifadden fecřen, ttekksent as tijɛinna marra u iɣembab nsen warɣen marra.
Mani iǧa řexxu řmargeḥ n wayraden, d řmedweř n wayraden imeẓyanen, mani yuyur weyrad, aqa-tt d tayradt ak-d weyrad ameẓyan am uřa d ijj issnexřeɛ i-ten?
Mani iǧa řexxu wayrad nni imezzqen min ḥdajen tarwa nnes u ijeyyef i tayradin nnes, d wenni iccuren ifran nnes s ukecceḍ, d imucan nnes n udurri zi min ittwacarrgen?

Xzar, Necc ad iřiɣ xak, ammu i iqqar SIDI n řɛeskarat, Necc ad arreɣ ikarruten nnec d ddexxan. Ad cceɣ ssif iyraden nnec imeẓyanen, u Necc ad qeḍɛeɣ takeccaḍt nnec zi temmurt u ɛemmarṣ ɛad ad tᵉttwaseř tmijja n ireqqasen nnec.

footnotes.text: deg idmaren nsent- s Tɛibranit ‘deg wuřawen nsent’.
tmijja n ireqqasen nnec- xzar Ica. 36:13, 37:9.
